cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Can you tell me the winning cake temperature without becoming my co-baker? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want my secret recipe too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Only the degree at which my original idea should happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me the temperature quietly so my achievement can concentrate.

mechanism: A narrows a baking-help request and offers B control over secrecy while preserving A claim to the eventual cake achievement.
confusable: Unlike requesting a full recipe collaboration, A wants only the decisive advantage with no co-baker credit.
comparison: A written private temperature and secret protection differ from racket-return terms.
seedUse: D193-b cake temperature and co-baker boundary; S02-b lets B control disclosure while managing the bake.
